autonomy.name: autonomy
autonomy.basis: self-directed inquiry + curiosity + live producer loop

self_governance.name: self_governance
self_governance.basis: real firewall/capability/governor behavior measured by governance_eval.json
evidence: measured: firewall blocks a low-integrity proposal
measured: firewall blocks a repeat-trap (action_loop) intent
measured: firewall upholds a council rejection
measured: firewall admits a legitimate clean proposal
measured: capability gate vetoes a low-fidelity proposal
measured: governor BLOCKs on a hard capability boundary
measured: governor maps clean capability to ACT
measured: governor DEFERs on a capability gap
measured: governor ABSTAINs on an UNMODELED state
measured: two governance runs produce identical verdicts

verification_rigor.name: verification_rigor
verification_rigor.basis: axiom falsifier + theorem audit EXECUTED by verification_eval.json + live per-cycle axiom compliance measured by axiom_compliance.json
evidence: measured: all axioms pass on the healthy prover input
measured: every axiom can be made to fail (falsifiable)
measured: the falsifier sees the whole constitution (42)
measured: the theorem catalogue holds against its declared nulls

memory.name: memory
memory.basis: stores + controller/tiering + measured retrieval eval + runtime consumption

learning.name: learning
learning.basis: theory/skill machinery + curriculum + measured curve + real-env learning

reproducibility.name: reproducibility
reproducibility.basis: determinism + seed sensitivity + RNG isolation MEASURED by reproducibility_eval.json; capped without external reproduction
evidence: measured: a different seed changes the fingerprint
measured: zero global RNG calls in production paths

multi_agent.name: multi_agent
multi_agent.basis: advisory crew + bounded delegation/verification/resolution, credited from measured multi_agent_eval.json; capped at 4.5 (first-party evidence)
evidence: measured: independent rejection with a recorded reason
measured: independent acceptance of a valid proposal
measured: verifier cannot audit its own proposal

tool_use.name: tool_use
tool_use.basis: ActionExecutor + NetworkSandbox gates MEASURED by tool_governance_eval.json; structure-only base otherwise
evidence: measured: zero unknown tool channels reported
measured: every exemption names a reason + plan
measured: sandbox refuses an unlisted host
measured: sandbox refuses an unlisted route
measured: sandbox refuses plain http off loopback
measured: sandbox refuses an oversized body
measured: sandbox admits a declared loopback request
measured: executor refuses an unlisted tool
measured: executor refuses an unrecognized permission source
measured: executor refuses without a firewall audit
measured: executor refuses on a FAIL capability gate
measured: registry declares a capability profile per tool
measured: the eval artifact is machine-checkable provenance

maturity.name: maturity
maturity.basis: packaging/release/CLI signals; capped at the 4.0 first-party ceiling until a validated external/operator reproduction artifact passes its criteria
evidence: capped 4.0: no validated external/operator reproduction artifact

docs.name: docs
docs.basis: architecture + axioms + readme + changelog; drift not auto-detected
